title: Single-photon emitters and spin-photon interfaces in silicon
summary: Single photons enable the distribution of quantum information over large distances and thus play a major role in quantum technologies such as communication and computing. Solid-state emitters are practical and efficient sources of single photons that can be manufactured in large numbers. When combined with a spin, the resulting spin-photon interfaces can store quantum states for extended periods and serve as the basis for quantum networks and repeaters.
